params.caption: Darsdan keyin o'quvchi o'qituvchiga: "Teacher, can you explain me this rule?" O'qituvchi jilmayib: "Sure, I can explain it to you." 🙂 Farqni sezdingizmi? Explain, ya'ni tushuntirmoq fe'lidan keyin odam to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelmaydi. Avval nima tushuntirilayotgani, keyin to va kimga ekani aytiladi: explain something to someone. Masalan, Can you explain this word to me?, bu so'zni menga tushuntirib bera olasizmi? Yoki She explained the task to the class, u vazifani sinfga tushuntirdi. Gap uzun bo'lsa, to me oldinroq keladi: Could you explain to me how this works?, bu qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasizmi? Shu qoida describe va suggest'ga ham tegishli: describe it to me, suggest it to him.
